meta.name: Generator Test
meta.notes: Exercises generator mechanics: (a) generator fires at load because [1,1] is initially empty; (b) generator fires mid-episode when agent picks the produced bucket at [1,1] freeing the cell; (c) generator exhausts after two firings (remaining reaches 0). Reachability never propagates through the generator cell [0,1] — [1,1] is reachable only via the side path through [1,0] and [0,0]. Solvable under correct play.
